definitions.gloss: counter for ships and large vessels
definitions.explanation: Counts ships such as tankers, ferries and warships. Small boats are usually counted with a different counter (see the notes).

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二隻|にせき}⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三隻|さんせき}⟦{止|と}まっている→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Three large ships are anchored in the harbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧{保安庁|ほあんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巡視船|じゅんしせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何隻|なんせき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Several Coast Guard patrol boats gathered at the scene of the accident.

notes:
COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一隻|いっせき}, {二隻|にせき}, {三隻|さんせき}, {四隻|よんせき}, {五隻|ごせき}
- {六隻|ろくせき}, {七隻|ななせき}, {八隻|はっせき}, {十隻|じゅっせき}
- {何隻|なんせき}: how many ships

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {艘|そう}: counter for small boats such as rowing boats and fishing boats
- {台|だい}: counter for machines and vehicles; not used for ships in careful speech, though heard in casual talk
